display_name: LoRa W24 跨 chirp 固定三臂正式 Full 补测
description: Run the registered, frozen three-arm Full matrix once regardless of source accuracy.
authorization: User requires formal Full test performance. Source scores are diagnostic.

code.commit: Resolved Git HEAD of the recorded branch at publication
code.environment: N607 CPU FP32 W24 archive, at most one prediction shard worker with two intraop threads and two replay workers; local independent CPU scorer.
code.cwd: Immutable formal release controller then original W24 archive for prediction workers.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Same sealed order of 15 held-out receivers x 2000 physical IDs; source V diagnostic only.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Registered LoRa source/target contract with independent source seed, namespace and packets.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: All three fixed readouts evaluated once. Frozen-same-row Full prediction uses received IQ only, followed by independent truth-last scoring.

checkpoint.initialization: No adjustment. Use terminal Peer Spectral trained at 48,000 source updates, frozen Practical half and prior 24,000-step direction; E104 unchanged.

sources.role: Independent source diagnosis and terminal 48000-step shared within/cross-chirp checkpoint.
Frozen original fixed-dose direction, matched actual comparison.
Frozen source-only native Practical exact-additive base for all three new readouts.
Immutable blind direct, old DURA half, complex-response half and wide all-packet half controls, same physical packets.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Registered source U and physical IDs for scratch fitting. All comparison checkpoints and frozen E104 opened only for post-freeze comparison.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Reuse matching source-only terminal freeze and no target or W24 fitting.
checkpoint.selection_rule: All three fixed readouts. No accuracy threshold for formal prediction. No target feedback.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only. One new shard worker with two intraop threads and two replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Preserve and reuse the prior same matrix if all three prediction shards are frozen; otherwise run after prior verified no-prediction closure. Stop for inconsistent predecessor, contract, smoke, prediction or scorer technical failure.

expected_artifacts: independent scores/scores.json with RX and TX results

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: runs/20261127-phase1-lora-w24-formal-peer-spectral-cpu-s2026092702-r02/predictions, or the original frozen r01 matrix
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: w24_peer_formal_collect, original scorer on reuse; independently reads truth after all sealed shards.

rows.method: Full with frozen E104 and fixed learned within and cross chirp ablations
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.budget_ref: 3 independent 10,000 packet prediction shards. Same E104 and seven scenes; no fit.
expected_artifacts: independent scores/scores.json with RX and TX results

notes: Full acceptance requires >=162000/180000 six practical, >=25500/30000 low urban and >=28566/30000 clean.
Source metrics are diagnostics. The prior controller keeps responsibility for the same matrix if it produces it. The new run only predicts when that controller records no target prediction.
Original fixed Practical CPU test is independent. Report CPU-vs-archive direct disagreement.
Full only. No Residual or weak route. No retraining or target feedback.
